title: TMPX Chunk
description: A single provider TMPX chunk — the provider-local `slot_id` (declared at registration in `tmpx_slots`) and its opaque URL-safe `value`. Same shape on both hops of the Identity Match response: providers emit `tmpx_chunks[]` on the provider→router shape, the router forwards them under `tmpx_providers[provider_id].chunks[]` on the router→publisher shape. Publisher-local destination names never appear here — the publisher's deployment configuration resolves `(provider_id, slot_id)` → local destination via publisher-tmpx-config.json.

slot_id.description: Provider-local slot identifier from the emitting provider's registered `tmpx_slots` (provider-registration.json). Opaque provider-namespaced token; publishers map `(provider_id, slot_id)` → local destination via `tmpx_macro_mapping`. NOT an ad-server macro name.

value.description: Opaque, URL-safe wire string the publisher substitutes verbatim into the destination the publisher's mapping resolves for this `(provider_id, slot_id)` pair. Publishers MUST NOT parse, decode, or transform this value.
